summary: Clark County, Idaho Lookout Butte listed under Caribou-Targhee NF by location code only; no build, staffing or fate found, and an Idaho County tower shares the name.

evidence.supports: Lookout Butte listed under Clark County
Separate Lookout Butte in Idaho County at 46.04591, -115.65941, standing tower
evidence.quote: Lookout Butte Idaho 46.04591 -115.65941 Tower Standing NHLR US 769, ID 59

sources.title: Idaho Lookouts - Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Only the Idaho Forest Lookouts page names this Clark County Lookout Butte, and it gives agency and location code only. firelookout.org's Idaho list has no Clark County Lookout Butte (its Clark entries are Lookout Point and Lookout Mountain). The Lookout Butte history in search snippets (1923 platform, 1935 tower, 1962 replacement, Recreation.gov listing) belongs to the Idaho County tower near Lowell on the Nez Perce-Clearwater and was NOT used here. The brief coordinates (44.2147, -111.438) are not confirmed by any page read. A climbing-guide snippet describes an unnamed butte near Island Park with no tower mentioned; not used. Suggest confirming with the Ashton/Island Park district whether this is a real historic site or a mis-keyed name.
